subject: science
passage: Each spring, bar-headed geese that spend the winter in India fly north over the Himalayas to breeding grounds on the Tibetan Plateau and in Mongolia, crossing terrain more than 5,000 meters high. Air at such heights holds far less oxygen than air at sea level, and its thinness makes flapping flight harder, since each wingbeat pushes against fewer air molecules. Some physiologists propose that the geese ease the crossing by flying over the highest ground mainly at night and in the early morning, when the air is colder and therefore denser, rather than in the afternoon, when winds blowing up the mountain slopes might seem to offer an advantage.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the physiologists' proposal?

choices.A: Bar-headed geese have larger lungs relative to their body size than most other kinds of geese do.
choices.B: Geese crossing the Himalayas fly in V-shaped flocks more often than geese flying over the plains.
choices.C: Tracked geese crossed the highest passes mostly before dawn, even on days when afternoon winds favored them.
choices.D: Tracked geese made most of their highest crossings in the afternoon, when upslope winds were strongest.

explanation.why: The proposal is about timing: the geese should cross the highest ground when the air is cold and dense, not when afternoon winds might help. Support would show geese choosing the cold hours even when the afternoon offered helpful winds, since that choice reveals what the geese favor.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Large lungs are a different adaptation to thin air and say nothing about when the geese choose to fly.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Flying in V-shaped flocks may save energy, but it does not show that the geese time their crossings to the coldest hours.
explanation.C: Correct. The geese preferred the cold hours before dawn even when afternoon winds would have helped, just as the proposal predicts.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Crossing mostly in the afternoon, when winds help, would contradict the proposal rather than support it.
